Zaubacorp and TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403; IndiaMART returned HTTP 429 and is in any case a product catalogue, which per Rule 5 does not count as shipment fact. The only address signal is from the ImportKey header: "SOUTH PHASE 100A AAMBATTHUR INDUSTRIAL ESTATE" (Chennai, Tamil Nadu), consistent with the claimed state but not evidence of supply. Domestic turnover: null — not public in the sources reachable.
note: Direction correction is the key finding: the 2,532-record customs footprint is IMPORT traffic into India (Chennai Air Cargo INMAA4 / Chennai Sea INMAA1), not exports. The company appears to be a Chennai-based importer/distributor of lab-metallography and testing consumables (Kulzer GmbH, Lab Testing Technologies, Metlab Corporation, Spectrographic Ltd appear as suppliers), which fits the claimed 'IT and electronics' industry only loosely — the visible goods are abrasives, polishing machines, motors and lab consumables. Declared HS 851690 was NOT observed in any visible row; observed HS codes were 73201019, 90249000, 84136090, 68052010 — so the declared code should be treated as unverified rather than corrected, since no single dominant code is established from 5 rows. Export status is none_found, not declared_only: the company's own site/catalogue was never used as a basis, and no export claim was found to record. Domestic supply: no traces of supply found in the reachable sources — this is a data-access gap (403/429 on all Indian registries), so it is recorded as unknown rather than none_found, and must not be read as 'conditionally accepted'. PAN AABCC5678E was not verifiable from any reachable source and is not confirmed. No rejection grounds apply: the entity is active in customs data as recently as 2026-02-28.
